name: PO Pilot — Wholesale PO Inbox → Shopify Draft Order

parameters.content:
## PO Pilot n8n template #1: hands-off PO intake

**Flow:** IMAP inbox → PDF→text → AI extraction (JSON) → Shopify SKU lookup → draft order with NET terms + tags.

**Setup (10 min):**
1. In `Wholesale PO Inbox`: connect your IMAP credentials (e.g. orders@yourbrand.com), keep *Download Attachments* on.
2. In BOTH HTTP nodes: replace `YOUR-STORE.myshopify.com` and `YOUR_SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN` (custom app token, scopes: read_products, write_draft_orders).
3. In `Extract Lines (AI)`: connect your OpenAI credential (or swap this node for the Anthropic node — same prompt works).
4. In `Build Line Items`: set your wholesale multiplier (default 0.6 = 40% off catalog).
5. Activate. Every new PO email becomes a draft order in Shopify Admin → Orders → Drafts.

**Safety:** AI extraction is best-effort. The Code nodes flag `no_match`, `price_mismatch`, `case_pack` and `low_inventory` warnings into the draft-order note — review flagged drafts before sending invoices.

nodes.name: PO Text (PDF/DOCX)
nodes.notes: If the PO arrived as plain email text (no attachment), bypass this node and map `{{ $json.text }}` from the trigger instead.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'query($q: String!) { products(query: $q, first: 3) { nodes { id title variants(first: 10) { nodes { id sku title price inventoryQuantity } } } } }', variables: { q: $json.sku ? 'sku:' + $json.sku : $json.title } }) }}

nodes.name: Collect Lines
nodes.notes: Default mode: aggregates all line items back into ONE item (list under `data`).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: 'mutation($input: DraftOrderInput!) { draftOrderCreate(input: $input) { draftOrder { id name invoiceUrl totalPrice } userErrors { field message } } }', variables: $json.variables }) }}

meta.description: PO Pilot bundle template #1 — automated wholesale PO intake: IMAP → AI extraction → Shopify catalog validation → draft order with net terms, PO tags and review warnings.
